metadata.method: RAD header LMST, start inclusive/end exclusive; duration SI seconds converted by 86400/88775.244. One clock wrap inferred from chronological observations; original header retained. No UTC offset correction applied.
metadata.quality: All RAD QC retained. Raw REMS flags and -999 values retained in pairs. Summary means exclude -999 only, with no sensor-specific quality filtering; these are descriptive, not analysis-ready.
